expected_behavior: When enable=true, the controller increases pump_cmd when cell temperature exceeds temp_ref_C (with hysteresis and PI action). The coolant loop removes heat with a pump-dependent UA that saturates at high pump_cmd. Under a step increase in i_load_A, heat_gen_W rises nonlinearly (I^2*R(T,SOC) + |I|*k_pol), causing temp_cell_C to rise; the loop reacts by ramping pump_cmd toward saturation and then settling, keeping temp_cell_C within safe bounds without sustained oscillation. Under a rise in ambient_temp_C, coolant_temp_C increases and the controller compensates by increasing pump_cmd, but heat removal capacity degrades as (T_coolant - T_amb) shrinks.
